supporting_evidence: Existing runtime stack split semantics create one new instance identity and retain the source identity.
Bank and merchant transfers already preserve full-stack identity and use atomic rollback.
Quantity-sensitive transaction paths require the same split-before-transfer lifecycle primitive.
assumptions: Only definitions explicitly projected as stackable may use partial quantity operations.
Native pricing and currency mutation remain owned by Economy and are not inferred here.
Native automatic destination-stack merging is not activated without evidence.
safe_fallback: Reject invalid quantities; transfer the entire existing instance only when the requested quantity equals the stack quantity; do not infer Classic stackability.
runtime_impact: Atomic partial deposit, withdrawal, merchant sale, and merchant purchase with one new transferred instance ID.
character_save_impact: Source and split quantities plus both instance IDs persist through the existing item-state serializer.
world_state_impact: Merchant stock receives the split instance; bank state retains character ownership and bank location.
native_dependencies: Native price and currency transaction ordering
